name: Tettei Anal Chiiku ~Kocchi ga, Kimochi Yosugite...~
original_name: 徹底アナル恥育 ～こっちが、気持ち良すぎて…～
source:
When I woke up, I was in a love hotel.
With a girl I didn’t recognize.

“You brought me here, but you don’t remember anything?”

Yesterday was the welcome party for new students.
I drank way too much, and the conversation turned dirty. I ended up spilling everything about my… uh, preference for anal.
I think… there was one girl who just sat there quietly, listening to me.

Did I… do it?
…Did I actually go through with it?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx/work/=/product_id/VJ012469.html/]dlsite[/url]]
